concepts.def: Indian melodic mode and mood pattern.
Indonesian ensemble of tuned metal percussion.

walkthroughs.body_html: Indian classical music uses the sitar and tabla drums. A raga is a melodic mode tied to a mood or time of day. A drone sustains underneath.
A gamelan is a group from Java or Bali in Indonesia. It is mostly tuned metal percussion — gongs, metallophones, chimes. The sound is shimmering and hypnotic.
Indian music uses microtones — pitches smaller than a semitone. Western pianos can only play 12 notes per octave; Indian singers can use over 20.
